_source: The native registry of the power-quests-1 bench run (2026-10-25, kubejs-exported/items.json, format gg-items-1: 34,559 items and 1,402 fluids): every item and fluid id that LuV A2's composed recipes ask Item.exists / Fluid.exists about (the naquadah plant's three modes, the platinum plant's attack, mode 3 and mode 4), plus the LuV parallel hatch, its recipe's parts, the LuV energy hatch and reactor III's rods; each one checked to be in that registry. A1's registrations (startup_scripts/grindless/luv/foundation.js: grindless:asteroid_pgm_concentrate) came after that run and are read from A1's script instead.
_how_it_is_used: tools/analysis/test/luv-a2-ids.test.mjs runs both plants' scripts with Item.exists / Fluid.exists answering only from this list and A1's published ids (global.grindless.luvFoundation.items), so a wrong id (a misspelt GTM form, an id the pack does not register) skips a mode and fails the test, where a permissive stand-in would have accepted it.
Adding an id to these recipes: check it in a native items.json first, then add it here. Never add an id that is not in a native registry export.
